easyPrerequisites:
Mona Lisa and Clever Conjurer do not have summoning sickness.
Mona Lisa has power 2 or greater.
description:
Activate Mona Lisa by tapping it, adding at least {W}{W}
Activate Clever Conjurer by tapping it, targeting Halo Fountain.
Holding priority, activate Halo Fountain by paying {W}{W}, tapping it, and untapping Clever Conjurer and Mona Lisa, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Clever Conjurer ability, untapping Halo Fountain.
Repeat.
